title: FishWater Outfitters
specs: Targeting shallow-water redfish on tidal creeks, grass flats, and oyster beds
blurb: Guests fish for redfish in salt marshes, tidal creeks, and Lowcountry flats around Charleston, South Carolina. Trips focus on sight fishing tailing redfish on the flats and exploring backwaters. Both fly fishing and light-tackle spin fishing are offered, with all gear provided and all experience levels welcome.
extraNote: Convenient launches near Charleston Harbor and surrounding barrier islands · Mid-April through mid-November
highlights: Targeting shallow-water redfish on tidal creeks, grass flats, and oyster beds
meetingPoint: Convenient launches near Charleston Harbor and surrounding barrier islands

quotes.text: +0Braden took me and my 7 year old son out for a half day chasing redfish on the marsh, and we absolutely loved it! I got to throw flies at fish pushing the shallows, and hooked up on several good ones with the spin rod as well. It was my son’s first guided trip, and needless to say he’s caught the bug just like I did at his age. Braden was patient and a great teacher with him, while also giving us great opportunities at big fish. When we’re back in Kiawah next year, he’ll be our first phone call! 10/10!

+0Our weekend trip to Charleston wouldn't have been complete without Braden. Super quick to respond, and he got us on the water and on some reds despite the not so ideal conditions. I've fished with guides from all over and Braden is among the best. Nothing but great vibes out there! Pro tip- ask the man where to eat and have some drinks. Take his advice. Thank me later. Looking forward to getting back out in the near future. Thanks again!

quotes.author: Tom Quail
quotes.text: I booked a guide trip yesterday with Braden Powell, owner of Fishwater Outfitters, down in the Charleston, South Carolina area, for red fish. It was a great trip and Braden is a great guide. I had quite a bit of trouble casting and double hauling the 9wt rod. It was just too heavy for me and my bad shoulder. Braden was very patient. I would highly recommend booking a trip with Braden, and Fishwater Outfitters.

+0Our time fishing with Capt. Powell and FishWater Outfitters was a blast. It was our first time experiencing South Carolina redfish and will certainly not be our last. Braden was kind, good-spirited, and very helpful for both myself and my wife. Landing fish each day was a great bonus. Would 10/10 recommend for everyone from the most accomplished angler to someone brand new to the sport.

quotes.author: Bryan Brinson
quotes.text: If you are looking for a charter out of or near Charleston look no further. My wife and I recently fished with Braden and had a wonderful time with lots of success. Knowledgeable, friendly and accommodating.
+0Capt. Braden went above and beyond to make our trip a success. His knowledge put us on a great class of fish. Highly recommend for the ultimate low country fishing experience.
